task.title: Verify exact-head merge readiness fail closed
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/725 by turning the Rust, CodeRabbit, and unresolved-thread merge policy into one deterministic read-only verifier.
acceptance_criteria: Require the requested expected head to equal both the live PR head and the successful Rust quality gate head.
Authenticate CodeRabbit evidence and reject rate-limited, limit-reached, paused, failed, or stale exact-head results even when their status is green.
Require a substantive exact-head review object or authenticated no-finding summary and zero unresolved review threads.
Emit deterministic READY or BLOCKED diagnostics without mutating or merging the pull request.

attempts.summary: Converted the PR 724 incident into RED verifier fixtures.
attempts.diagnostic: The repository had prose merge rules but no executable check preventing auto-merge from accepting stale review evidence or false-green exact-head rate-limit text.
attempts.patch: Added offline fixtures and shell tests for a ready PR and the real sanitized PR 724 rate-limited exact-head shape.

attempts.summary: Implemented an authenticated exact-head readiness verifier.
attempts.diagnostic: GitHub GraphQL review objects, check runs, status contexts, comments, and review threads provided enough evidence for a deterministic fail-closed decision without write authority.
attempts.patch: Added scripts/verify-merge-readiness, just verify-merge-readiness, stable diagnostics, documentation, and tests covering head mismatch, Rust failure, stale or spoofed reviews, rate limits, and unresolved threads.

attempts.summary: Hardened evidence parsing during independent and CodeRabbit review.
attempts.diagnostic: Review exposed authentication and exact-head summary edge cases that could otherwise accept creator-spoofed status or reject genuine summary-only evidence.
attempts.patch: Authenticated status creators and bot authors, constrained exact-head commit ranges, rejected contradictory failure text, and added regression fixtures before merge.

outcome.summary: Merge readiness now has a repository-owned, deterministic, read-only fail-closed verifier that binds Rust and substantive CodeRabbit evidence to the requested exact head and rejects unresolved threads.

lessons: High-consequence process rules should become executable checks rather than remain prose conventions.
A successful status conclusion is not enough when its authenticated body reports review rate limiting or failure.
Review evidence must be bound to the exact PR head and an authenticated bot identity.
Read-only verification should report blockers deterministically and remain separate from merge authority.
Real sanitized incident payloads make process regressions reproducible without preserving secrets or developer paths.
